title: Typography / Large-format scale — 8x table

location.series: IBM Design Language / alternate tab states
location.label: 8x

slide_intent: Match typography to a substantially larger presentation while retaining script proportions, because readable scale depends on how the work is encountered.
strategic_value: An 8x extension of the same system can keep IBM signage and larger digital artwork consistent with smaller communications.
demonstration: The selected 8x tab presents default sizes 48–2400, 95% adjusted values and line heights through 2640 in a complete three-column table.
practical_value: Select 8x only after identifying the relevant format, then use the corresponding line-height value rather than sizing text independently.

content_islands.name: Default and adjusted columns
content_islands.spec: Pair the larger default sizes with the corresponding 95% script-adjusted sizes.

content_islands.name: Line-height column
content_islands.spec: Align each line-height value or alternative with its type-size row.

reference_purposes.Intent: The accompanying page ties large-format scaling to artboard size and viewing distance.
reference_purposes.Application: The 8x table supplies the coordinated type-size and line-height values for that multiplier.
reference_purposes.Constraint: The parent guidance gives human-scale print and 16K digital artboards as 8x examples and says these rules assume 100% artwork scale.
